body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized camera, 57 x 39 x 33 mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring right of centre (a quarter of the width), flash window upper left, shutter and recessed switch on top left over the grip, USB-C and microSD on the right side. Idea TIDAL BELLOWS, a tiny optical bench: a crisp matte black front plate (lens standard) and back plate (sliding battery door) are joined by a band of sharp zig-zag bellows pleats wrapping the body. The pleats are wide and calm at the grip end and squeezed ever tighter toward the lens end, like matter crushed by tides near a black hole. Below, a clip-on rail foot with engraved ticks, fine gear rack and knurled thumb knob (tripod insert). image[2] = bellows pleats, rail with engraved scale, gear rack, knurled knob. image[3] = knurled pads, red tabs, machined lever. image[4] = lines compressing toward a dark mass. Vertical grip ribs front left, frosted flash window, knurled shutter collar, switch in a pocket, ribbed lens ring, red index dot, flush pins at plate corners, vents, light-pipe dots. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
